en_title: GTA 6 Fans Baffled After Jason's Actor Gets Left Out of Game Awards Nominations
cn_title: Jason的演员未获游戏大奖提名，《GTA6》粉丝感到困惑
opus_summary: 《GTA6》获得The Game Awards八项提名，Lucia的扮演者Manni L. Perez获最佳表演提名，而另一位主角Jason的演员未获提名，令部分粉丝意外。目前Jason的扮演者尚未确定，游戏将于明早在新西兰等部分地区正式上线。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 fans are a bit surprised that the actor playing Jason wasn't nominated at The Game Awards.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》粉丝对饰演Jason的演员没有获得游戏大奖提名感到有些意外。

paragraphs.en: Earlier today, The Game Awards gave us our first indicator of how GTA 6 will be received. It's up for eight awards, including Game of the Year . It was a bit odd, as there are no reviews for the game at the moment, but the jury clearly deemed it worthwhile. The other notable thing to come out of the Game Awards nominations was that it confirmed the actress for Lucia: Manni L. Perez . Fans have speculated she was Lucia for years now, but now it's confirmed, as she was nominated for Best Performance.
paragraphs.cn: 今天早些时候，游戏大奖首次让我们看到了《GTA6》可能获得怎样的反响。它获得了包括年度游戏在内的八项提名。这有些奇怪，因为目前还没有这款游戏的评测，但评审团显然认为它值得获得提名。游戏大奖提名名单带来的另一件值得注意的事，是确认了Lucia的演员：Manni L. Perez。多年来，粉丝一直猜测她就是Lucia的演员，而如今随着她获得最佳表演提名，这一点得到了证实。

paragraphs.en: However, the actor who plays the game's other protagonist was not nominated. Fans were taken aback, since the two are clearly a package deal in the game, and one has to imagine they elevate each other. However, the jury must not have felt strongly enough about Jason to give his actor the nomination. There's no rule against nominating multiple actors for a single project, either. Last year, three performers from Expedition 33 were all nominated in the same category, after all.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，饰演游戏中另一位主角的演员却没有获得提名。粉丝对此感到吃惊，因为两人在游戏中显然是一个整体，人们自然会认为他们的表演相得益彰。不过，评审团想必没有对Jason留下足够深的印象，因此没有提名他的演员。而且，也没有规则禁止同一部作品中的多名演员获得提名。毕竟，去年《Expedition 33》的三名表演者就同时获得了同一奖项的提名。

paragraphs.en: Jason has been seen as a much more subtle and reserved character compared to Lucia. He's a bit quieter, isn't too flashy with his actions, and maybe lacks the fire in his character compared to someone like Lucia. One fan on Reddit noted that Jason didn't make a strong impression on them in any of the trailers: "Honestly, I'm not a fan of his VO," they said . "Jason doesn't sound good, at least in the footage we saw; he lacks diction. Most of the time, I can't understand what he's saying without subs."
paragraphs.cn: 与Lucia相比，Jason一直被视为一个内敛含蓄得多的角色。他话少一些，行事不太张扬，而且与Lucia这样的人相比，他的性格或许缺少一股热情。一位Reddit粉丝指出，Jason在所有预告片中都没有给自己留下深刻印象：「说实话，我不喜欢他的配音。」「Jason的声音听起来不怎么样，至少在我们看到的片段中是这样；他吐字不清。大多数时候，没有字幕我就听不懂他说什么。」

paragraphs.en: However, another fan pushed back, noting that other great Rockstar actors have been snubbed in the past: "Benjamin Byron Davis wasn't nominated for his Dutch performance [in Red Dead Redemption 2]," they said . "Didn't take away one bit and [it's] arguably the best performance in the game."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，另一位粉丝提出了异议，指出过去也有其他出色的Rockstar演员未获提名：「Benjamin Byron Davis没有因为饰演Dutch［在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中］获得提名。」「这丝毫没有减损他的表现，而那可以说是游戏中最好的表演。」

paragraphs.en: It's certainly a valid point, especially since Rob Wiethoff also wasn't nominated for his role as John Marston in Red Dead Redemption 2, despite being a secondary protagonist. As of right now, we're not sure who is playing Jason, but it won't be long before we find out. GTA 6 will officially go live tomorrow morning in select regions, as the game becomes available in New Zealand . It'll be interesting to see which of the two protagonists fans end up gravitating toward more in the end, but it seems like Lucia may be a favorite based on her nomination.
paragraphs.cn: 这确实有道理，尤其是考虑到Rob Wiethoff也没有因为在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中饰演John Marston而获得提名，尽管他是第二主角。截至目前，我们还不确定是谁在饰演Jason，但用不了多久就会知道。《GTA6》将于明天早上在部分地区正式上线，届时游戏将在新西兰开放游玩。粉丝最终会更喜欢两位主角中的哪一位，将是一件有趣的事，但从Lucia获得提名来看，她似乎可能会更受欢迎。
